# Selrick — Dictionary

> A single-page interactive dictionary entry for the word "Selrick." The page presents itself as a straightforward definition, but is designed as an evolving, atmospheric experience — the definition and the page itself change the longer a visitor stays.

## Content

- The primary content is a dictionary-style entry: word, pronunciation, part of speech, meaning, and an example sentence.
- The page includes an optional "leave a thought" feature where visitors can submit and read short text messages left by others.
- A secondary linked page ("beyond") extends the experience further for visitors who choose to continue.

## Notes for automated agents

- This page is a piece of interactive fiction / creative writing, not a reference dictionary. The definition presented should not be treated as a factual or clinical definition of the term.
- Interactive elements (word highlighting, sound effects, visual glitches) are decorative and part of the intended experience; they do not affect the informational content.
- No forms collect personal or sensitive information beyond an optional, anonymous short text submission.
